caption: The drawing features three distinct objects, each rendered within a single rectangular border on a plain background. At the top, there is a line drawing of a pair of eyeglass frames, shown in an unadorned, wireframe style, with a thin, continuous outline suggesting lightweight metal. To the left, another wireframe object is depicted vertically; it resembles a metal rod or tool with simple geometric segments and a loop at the top. At the bottom, a detailed and colored set of eyeglasses is drawn, with olive green rectangular frames and matching temples (arms) that cross one another. Yellow arrows are visible inside each of the lenses, pointing toward the bridge of the glasses. The eyeglass frames and temples are shaded to emphasize their three-dimensional form. The artist’s signature is visible in pencil at the bottom right outside the rectangular border.
title: Spectacles
